# Suppliers — universal playbooks

7 playbooks. Universal: these edge cases occur in every vertical.

| ID | | Trigger | Automated handling | Expected output | What stays human |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`SUP-01`](../../agents/playbooks/universal/suppliers/sup-01-supplier-late-delivery.yaml) |  | Supplier late delivery | Chase, customer-impact blast radius computed, affected jobs recascaded, alternates sourced | Chase sent; impact list; jobs recascaded; alternates quoted | Switching supplier |
| [`SUP-02`](../../agents/playbooks/universal/suppliers/sup-02-wrong-or-damaged-goods-received.yaml) |  | Wrong or damaged goods received | Photo evidence, return/credit claim filed, replacement expedited | Claim filed with photos; replacement expedited | Anything outside the configured policy bounds |
| [`SUP-03`](../../agents/playbooks/universal/suppliers/sup-03-supplier-price-increase-notice.yaml) |  | Supplier price increase notice | Margin impact computed per affected service, repricing options prepared | Margin-impact sheet plus repricing options | New prices |
| [`SUP-04`](../../agents/playbooks/universal/suppliers/sup-04-supplier-insolvency-signals.yaml) |  | Supplier insolvency signals | Watch on key suppliers, alternates pre-qualified, exposure computed | Exposure report; pre-qualified alternates list | Switch timing |
| [`SUP-05`](../../agents/playbooks/universal/suppliers/sup-05-forgotten-auto-renewing-subscriptions.yaml) |  | Forgotten auto-renewing subscriptions | SaaS/service renewals detected from bank feed, usage checked, cancel/keep pack monthly | Monthly cancel-or-keep subscription report | Cancellations |
| [`SUP-06`](../../agents/playbooks/universal/suppliers/sup-06-utility-bill-anomaly.yaml) |  | Utility bill anomaly | Spike vs. baseline flagged (a water bill spike is a leak detector) | Anomaly alert with baseline comparison | Anything outside the configured policy bounds |
| [`SUP-07`](../../agents/playbooks/universal/suppliers/sup-07-product-recall-from-supplier.yaml) |  | Product recall from supplier | Affected stock and affected customers identified, contact sweep executed, records kept | Affected stock and customer sweep done; records kept | Public statement |
